slides.title: Key questions

paragraphs.text: Key questions
Should Onsoo enter the US market in 2027, and if so by which route, within an $18M cash cap, payback by 2030 and an 8% group margin floor?
Is the US an attractive market for Onsoo in 2027?
Does an Amazon-led entry meet the board's cash, payback, margin and growth objectives?
Would a national specialty-retail launch be the better route?
Does the answer survive ad cost, tariff and downside risk, and does it beat a Japan scale-up?
How should Onsoo launch, and what tells the board to scale, slow or stop?
Decision maker
Success criteria
Timing
Out of scope
CEO Park Ji-won with the board, choosing a route (or no US entry) for 2027

US cash need of $18M or less through 2030; US cash flow back to zero by end 2030; Group operating margin of 8% or more every year; On the way to $40M of US revenue by 2030; One major new-market launch in 2027
Board meeting, March 2027
Routes the planning team did not model; US and Japan launches in the same year

slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US through Amazon in 2027, not national retail, and gate spend on keeping ad cost near the pilot level
The US is worth entering: K-beauty is taking share, its buyers shop on Amazon, and Onsoo's pilot already sells
–	K-beauty grew US sales 89% in 2021–25, against 22% for all facial skincare
Amazon-led entry meets the board's cash, payback and margin limits, but reaches two-thirds of the $40M ambition by 2030
–	Cash need peaks at $1.9M in 2027 and is repaid in 2030
A national retail launch would break the cash cap and the margin floor, and its assumptions do not hold
–	Cash need reaches $20.8M by 2030, above the $18M cap
Ad cost is the swing factor: payback needs ACoS at or below 28.6%; above that, Japan becomes the better 2027 choice
–	Brands scaling on Amazon pay a median 32%; the pilot ran at 28%
Approve an Amazon-led launch for 2027 with quarterly gates; add retail only once awareness passes 20%
–	Five gates, led by ACoS, decide each quarter: scale, slow or switch to Japan
